veranderings.voor: voordat hy by die regte mens kan uitkom
veranderings.na: voordat dit by die regte mens kan uitkom
veranderings.rede: 'hy' can be read as the carrier ('iemand') rather than the letter; 'dit' points clearly to the letter.
'gelos' is colloquial for 'left behind'; 'gelaat' is the standard written form.

veranderings.voor: het geweet om daar te kyk
veranderings.na: het geweet dat hulle daar moet kyk
veranderings.rede: 'geweet om ... te kyk' calques English 'knew to look'; a dat-clause is the natural Afrikaans construction.

veranderings.voor: Hulle kon net hoop dat daardie skip gou kom.
veranderings.na: Die seemanne kon net hoop dat daardie skip gou sou kom.
veranderings.rede: 'Hulle' now points to the next ship's people, who cannot be hoping their own ship comes; the hoping belongs to the seamen who left the letters, and the past needs 'sou kom'.

veranderings.voor: het ruiters te perd later die pos
veranderings.na: het ruiters later te perd die pos
veranderings.rede: Afrikaans puts time before manner (tyd-wyse-plek), so 'later te perd' reads naturally.
No particular letter has been introduced, so the general statement needs the indefinite article.
'in dieselfde jare' is wooden; 'in dieselfde tydperk' is the idiomatic way to say the same time.
The diminutive already says small, so 'klein briefie' is a pleonasm.

veranderings.voor: waar briewe gewag het vir die posman
veranderings.na: waar briewe vir die posman gewag het
veranderings.rede: In a subordinate clause the verb group goes last; the extraposed 'vir die posman' sounds English.

veranderings.voor: sakke vol pos tussen stede gery
veranderings.na: sakke vol pos tussen stede vervoer
veranderings.rede: Transitive 'ry' (to carry a load) is colloquial; 'vervoer' is the standard written verb.

veranderings.blok: Hoe die nuus by mense uitgekom het
veranderings.rede: The sentence is in the past, so the time clause needs the past form too.

veranderings.blok: Hoe die nuus by mense uitgekom het
veranderings.rede: 'drukkers' are printing machines or people; the place where newspapers are printed is a 'drukkery'.

veranderings.blok: Hoe die nuus by mense uitgekom het
veranderings.voor: vertel wat by die huis gebeur.
veranderings.na: vertel wat by die huis gebeur het.
veranderings.rede: The main clause is past tense, so the embedded clause should be past too.

veranderings.voor: Die posstelsel bestaan vandag nog en die stappe
veranderings.na: Die posstelsel bestaan vandag nog, en die stappe
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
Attributive 'later' takes the inflected form 'latere', and 'gelaat' is the standard written form of 'gelos'.

vlae.teks: 'n Klein papiertjie op 'n brief wat vir sy reis betaal.
vlae.rede: 'wat' grammatically attaches to 'brief', so the definition can read as the letter paying; fixing it cleanly needs a restructure (and 'Klein papiertjie' is a pleonasm) that may touch a shared definition, so a person or writer should decide.
